headline: Held security deposit hearings for tenants at 44 Loomis Street and 187 Pearl Street; no decisions recorded.
summary: The meeting covered two security deposit cases, one for 44 Loomis Street and one for 187 Pearl Street. In each case, the tenant and landlord gave evidence and testimony. The minutes do not record how either case ended.
plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, October 19, 2026, 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
https://zoom.us/j/97005742456  
 
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Emma Ramirez-Richer, and Dylan Shelby 
Staff present: Shay Brunvand 
Meeting called to order at 06:35 PM 
1. Emily Pecora (tenant); MDJ BTV LLC c/o Matthew Boudreau (Landlord) Security Deposit Case 
Re: 44 Loomis Street 
Present were Emily Pecora and Matthew Boudreau.  
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
2. Mathieson Jennings (tenant); 187 Pearl Street LLC c/o Chris Mason (landlord) Security Deposit 
Case Re: 187 Pearl Street 
Present were Mathieson Jennings and Chris Mason.  
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
The meeting was adjourned at 7:45 PM 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
